mapper.insert: INSERT INTO groups ( id, space_id, event_id, name, sort_order, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{name}, (SELECT coalesce(max(sort_order) + 1, 0) FROM groups WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId}), 0, #{actorUserId}, #{at}, #{at})

mapper.select: SELECT gp.id AS publication_id, gp.board_version, gp.snapshot::text AS snapshot, gp.published_at, u.display_name AS published_by_display_name FROM group_publications gp JOIN users u ON u.id = gp.published_by WHERE gp.space_id = #{spaceId} AND gp.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY gp.seq DESC LIMIT 1
